name: Macmic Science&Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, Macmic Science & Technology Co., Ltd. is a key player in the power semiconductor industry, focusing on the development, production, and distribution of advanced power semiconductor products and solutions. The company's diverse portfolio encompasses MOSFET modules, fast recovery epitaxial diodes (available as chips, discrete components, and modules), IGBTs (both discrete units and modules), rectifier diode modules (including three-phase bridge configurations), and thyristor modules. These offerings are integral to a wide range of applications, spanning from inverters for general, solar, and wind power, to welding equipment, switched-mode power supplies (SMPS), uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), induction heating, and various transportation products. Furthermore, their components are crucial for modern home appliances, electric vehicles, medical equipment, and motor drive systems.
